tips.text: Run Isolation Vault bounties first for Namalon and Lucent Teroglobe, fish Tethermaw during Vome, make one Plains trip for Ferros, and farm Argon on build day.
Run a Resource Booster while mining and fishing; it does not apply to bounty payouts.
Use a wide-vacuum loot frame such as a max-range Xaku to smash every container on the Drift.
Players already doing Deimos for Necramechs or Entrati standing get most of the list for free.
The complaints are about slow Deimos mining and fishing; some only do it with a double resource booster.
